policy: Production backtest/calibrators_by_market.json must equal an APPROVED entry below, market-for-market (method, params, supported region), and recommendation.CALIBRATION_VERSION must equal that entry's version. Changing production calibration requires a reviewed PR that adds a new approved entry with a bumped version, held-out AND forward evidence, and Jacob's authorization (engineering/AUDIT/README.md). The weekly recheck may only write candidates (backtest/calibrator_candidates.json).
